segments.text: [casual, friendly] I picked up my phone to check the time.
[light, amused] Then a friend sent me a video. I watched it… [short pause] and then another one.
[matter-of-fact] Ten minutes later, I put my phone down.
[surprised] Wait. [long pause] [confused] What time is it?
[warm, slowly] I only meant to check the time.
[warm, slowly] I ended up scrolling for ten minutes. [chuckles]
